symptom: PC cannot ping another PC in the same department
topology_note: Two PCs connected to the same switch; both should be in VLAN 10
show_output:
show vlan brief
10   USERS   active   Fa0/1
20   GUEST   active   Fa0/2
expected_fault: PC connected on Fa0/2 is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10

symptom: Users in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with their gateway
topology_note: Switch connects VLAN 20 PCs to router-on-a-stick gateway
show_output:
show vlan brief
10 USERS active Fa0/1-10
show interfaces trunk
Port Fa0/24
Vlans allowed on trunk: 10
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is missing from the trunk allowed VLAN list

symptom: PC connected to a switch port cannot communicate with other users in its VLAN
topology_note: Department network requires VLAN 30
show_output:
show vlan brief
10 USERS active Fa0/1-12
20 GUEST active Fa0/13-20
30 STAFF active
expected_fault: Access port is not assigned to required VLAN 30

symptom: Devices cannot communicate across two switches for VLAN 40
topology_note: Two switches are connected through an uplink; VLAN 40 should traverse both
show_output:
show interfaces trunk
Port Fa0/24
Status: not-trunking
Native vlan: 1
expected_fault: Inter-switch link is not configured as a trunk

show_output:
show vlan brief
10 USERS active
20 GUEST active
30 STAFF active
expected_fault: Required VLAN 50 does not exist on the switch

 10 permit ip any any
